messages.subject: Re: ctmm webinar, Q&A
parts:
I'm going to try to do this via Skype (fingers crossed). If you want to attend the webinar, then please message/email your Skype user name to me with the subject "ctmm webinar" so that I can add you to my contact list. I will initiate a group call at 9AM EST. If you only want to attend the Q&A session, then please make a note of that in your message/email and I will only add you to the group call at 10AM EST.

To keep the bandwidth down for everyone, please do not turn on outgoing video. I will be sharing my desktop screen, so you will want to see my feed.
To keep the noise level down, please keep your microphone muted when not asking a question. You can do this from within Skype by clicking the microphone icon. I also recommend a headset.
